acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce: GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=x GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=y go test -run TCP-V0-037 test fails before the fix
contextindex scrubs or pins Git identity env (TestMain or per-test t.Setenv) and the test passes with and without the variables set
body: Lane test-speed-1021i (PR #1461) observed internal/contextindex TCP-V0-037 failing when GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/EMAIL are exported in the caller's environment, as the lane charter requires for commits. The package has no TestMain that scrubs Git identity env, so the test result depends on the operator shell. Expected: hermetic pass regardless of GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_*.
